```{r}
births_data <- read.csv("C:/STAT112/project-ak-83/data/us_births_2016_2021.csv")
head(births_data)
```

> 

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(births_data, aes(x = Number.of.Births, y = State)) +
  geom_point()
```


```{r}
ggplot(births_data, aes(x = Education.Level.Code, y = Average.Age.of.Mother..years., color = Education.Level.Code)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.6) +  # Slight jitter, some transparency
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, aes(group = Education.Level.Code), linetype = "dashed") +  # Trend lines per group
  labs(
    title = "Average Age of Mothers by Education Level",
    x = "Education Level Code",
    y = "Average Age of Mother (years)",
    color = "Education Level"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )
```
